panels.scene: The Ruined Library at dusk. Smoke still curls from the stone.
panels.caption: Field note. The Ruined Library, at the door. Dusk.

panels.scene: Scorched shelves just inside the doorway.
panels.caption: The orcs burned this place long ago, and it still hasn't finished burning. You can smell it in the stone.

panels.scene: Natalie sits on the step outside, writing. Her hands shake.
panels.caption: Four of us went in at noon.

panels.scene: A small, quick goblin mid-leap with a knife. A crossbow string snaps.
panels.caption: It doesn't fight like a soldier. It fights like a child who found a knife and made up a game.

say.name: Natalie
say.text: It bit through the Archer's crossbow string.

panels.scene: The goblin hugs a stack of red books between the shelves.
panels.caption: What I don't know: why it stays.

say.name: Natalie
say.text: This one keeps the red books.

panels.scene: Natalie looks up from the page, straight at you.

say.name: Natalie
say.text: If you are reading this, you are about to go in. Stay low. Leave the red ones be until it looks away.

panels.caption: I will finish this note when I find them.
